Cause found and fixed, then verified on a running server. The twelve items refused in one session all carry holiday_restriction halloween_or_fullmoon, inherited from their prefab, and every one was allowed for the class it was handed to: the game will not attach a holiday restricted wearable while its holiday is not running, so the equip returns with m_hOwnerEntity unset and TF2Util_EquipPlayerWearable throws on exactly that assertion. BuildHatPool reads holiday_restriction from the schema once per class and skips anything carrying one, of which the schema has sixty. Verified: three waves of Decoy with six bots spawning and respawning after the fix, zero refusals in the plugin log and zero tf2utils exceptions in the error log, against eleven and twelve in comparable sessions before it.

The runner reported two differences between the arm and itself: defenders died 3.0 against 5.5, outside its band of 4 to 6, and held for 146.8 against 119.2, outside 104 to 136. Paired by wave number it is no better: arm a's second waves held 144, 150 and 180 seconds and arm b's held 127, 136 and 141, which barely overlap. Deaths on wave 2 were 4, 12 and 2 in one arm.

The floor is in plugin/docs/testbed-metrics.md as its own section rather than in this bead. Read plainly: on Decoy at six waves an arm, a difference in hold time or in deaths is the bed talking, and every threat priority reading mvm-z83.6 took on four waves an arm was inside it.
